notes.title: Update on Our Sales Campaign!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/97d80154037fc31013ef0da6004135ef24b37edc.png
We are ready to update our sales campaign results. 

Yes, we understood the goals we set were ambitious. And prizes were also overly attractive. We really were incredibly close to reaching the first milestone. It’s cool!

Your support through purchases, reviews, and everything else has been incredible. Because of this overwhelming support, we are happy to announce that we have still decided to implement the first item on our list. Additionally, we feel your passion and want to find a way to make you even happier.

Let's discuss what else you'd like to see from us from the provided list on our Discord.

Your love, voices, and opinions are inspirations for us. Maybe we will transform it into new challenges for our team.

Thank you for your amazing support!❤️❤️❤️

notes.content:

How do mermaids call their friends?
...
 On their "shell"-phones!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44859716/cefa6eed11fd5ec6c97e87d240295cb0590c295c.png
Here's the list of what we've done in the previous week:

 Finished all remaning renders for Lust Academy season 3.
 Retouched all remaning renders for Lust Academy season 3.
 Finished all remaning animations for Lust Academy season 3.
 Finished updating skins for BIO.
 Finished working on the save file transfer function for season 4.
 Finished planning storylines for Season 4.
 Finished sound design for Season 3.

As you can see, Lust Academy season 3 is almost finished and heading to its steam release, while we're already in preparation for Season 4. That's it for today!

One more: let us remind you about a chance to win Steam gift cards.

To participate, add Lust Academy Season 3 to your wishlist 🙏 and click the celebration emoji "🎉" in our Discord channel. 

 15 ones will receive $10 Steam Gift cards each. 
We aim to hit +5,000 new wishlists since the start of the contest for Season 3, and once we achieve that, we're upping the ante! We'll throw two extra $100 gift cards into the prize pool! Let's make it a reality 🌟
  
Just hit that participate button, and our trusty bot will randomly pick a winner. 
And remember, the more friends you invite to join and wishlist, the closer we get to that ultimate prize!

But here's the thing: we want to hear from YOU! We're eager to know which languages you would like to see our game translated into.

So, don't be shy! Drop your suggestions using the comments below and let us know which languages you'd love to see in our game. 

Your input matters, and your active participation in this vote will directly influence the future development of our game.

Remember: YOU are the ones shaping the future of the game.
